description: This file defines the VTJsonCondition class responsible for evaluating complex JSON-based conditions against entities within the vtiger CRM system.

classes.name: VTJsonCondition
classes.description: A class to evaluate JSON-encoded conditions on entities, supporting complex logical groupings and various condition types.

methods.name: evaluate
methods.description: Decodes a JSON condition, iterates over sub-conditions, and computes the overall boolean result based on logical operators and condition checks.

methods.name: startsWith
methods.description: Checks if a string starts with a specified substring.

methods.name: endsWith
methods.description: Checks if a string ends with a specified substring.

methods.name: checkCondition
methods.description: Evaluates individual conditions like equality, comparison, containment, regex matching, and change detection.
